title: Lasers and Math Can Help Doctors Deliver Just the Right Amount of Medicine
sourceName: National Institute of Standards and Technology
content: Henry Nonnemaker is an undergraduate at Case Western Reserve University, where he studies applied math, with a secondary major in English literature. Although he’s fond of the abstract, he likes math best when he can apply it to the real world. In his spare time, he’s a Magic: The Gathering player and amateur jazz saxophonist.
